description.value:
Cost 2 charges of Ghost-Static

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 hostile ghost-machine

Check Crafting, as a counteract check against the target's level

You reach into the machine and pull the spirit's hands off its own controls. Attempt a counteract check using Crafting. On a success the bound spirit loses command of the chassis for 1 minute: the machine goes inert, taking no actions and defending itself only. On a critical success the spirit is driven out entirely and the machine is inert until repaired or re-bound. On a failure it is unaffected and knows what you tried.
